versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces the "wait-what" skill for relentlessly interviewing users about a plan, decision, or idea.
- Utilizes a design tree to map decision points and their dependencies.
- Interviews proceed in structured rounds, presenting all immediately actionable (frontier) questions at once, each with a recommended answer.
- Recomputes the design tree after each user response to identify the next round of questions.
- Proactively gathers environmental facts using sub-agents rather than asking the user.
- Completes the session only once every decision branch has been thoroughly explored and understanding is confirmed with the user.
